auth.loginDescription: Sign in with your email address and password.
auth.passwordRules: Use at least 12 characters. Repeated characters, sequences, keyboard rows, and your email address or the site name are not allowed.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.description: Confirm your identity again before this operation.

reset.requestDescription: We will email a reset link to your registered address.
reset.requestSent: If the address is registered, we sent an email. Use the link in it to reset your password.
reset.passwordDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
reset.mfaDescription: This removes multi-factor authentication. Then sign in with your password and set it up again.
reset.mfaDone: Multi-factor authentication was removed. Sign in and set it up again.

invite.title: Workspace invitation
invite.asNew: Choose a password to create your account.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.empty: You don't belong to any workspace.

security.title: Account security
security.requiredDescription: This CMS requires multi-factor authentication for everyone. Other operations are unavailable until you set it up.
security.totpDescription: Use a 6-digit code from an authenticator app each time you sign in.
security.totpManual: Enter this key in your authenticator app.
security.totpOpenApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in with your device's biometrics or a security key.
security.recoveryDescription: Generating new codes makes the old ones stop working.
security.recoveryCodesDescription: Shown only on this screen. Store them somewhere safe. Each can be used once.
security.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. You were signed out on other devices.

errors.generic: The request could not be completed ({status}).
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_passkey: The passkey could not be verified.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: This screen cannot perform the operation. Please sign in again.
errors.weak_password: This password cannot be used. Check the rules.
errors.breached_password: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.reauth_failed: Your identity could not be confirmed.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
errors.account_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in, then accept the invitation.
errors.already_member: You already belong to this workspace.
errors.passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this server.
errors.mfa_already_enabled: The authenticator app is already set up.
errors.mfa_not_enabled: Multi-factor authentication is not set up.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.revision_conflict: Someone else saved this draft first. Reload it and apply your changes again.
errors.slug_taken: Another entry in this locale already uses this slug.
errors.invalid_entry: Part of the entry is not accepted.
errors.alt_text_missing: Some images have no alternative text, so the entry cannot be published.
errors.url_taken: Another published entry already uses this URL.
errors.nothing_to_correct: An entry that has never been published cannot be published as a correction.
errors.schema_migration_pending: Editing and publishing are paused while the schema migration is pending.
errors.schema_not_deployed: No schema has been applied to this workspace yet.
errors.unsupported_media_type: This image format is not supported.
errors.invalid_image: The image could not be read.
errors.image_too_large: The image has too many pixels.
errors.media_quota_exceeded: This would exceed the workspace's media storage limit.
errors.image_processing_timeout: Processing the image took too long.
errors.version_is_published: The published version cannot be erased.
errors.media_in_use: This media is used by entries.
errors.last_admin: A workspace must keep at least one administrator.
errors.smtp_required: Email (SMTP) is not configured, so only server administrators can invite.
errors.too_many_webhooks: No more webhooks can be added.
errors.server_admin_target: Server administrators can only be recovered with the server CLI.
errors.outside_scope: This person also belongs to a workspace you do not administer. Ask a server administrator.
errors.deploy_scope_forbidden: Only server administrators can issue tokens with the deploy scope.

editor.readonlyUnknown: This body contains elements the admin editor cannot handle ({names}), so it cannot be edited here.

link.title: Link
link.description: Enter the URL to link to. Leave it empty to remove the link.
link.invalid: Enter an https, http, mailto or tel URL, or a path starting with / or #.

image.missing: Add alternative text or mark the image as decorative. It cannot be published otherwise.

embed.title: Embed
embed.description: Enter an https URL from an allowed provider ({providers}).
embed.label: Embed URL
embed.notAllowed: This is not an https URL from an allowed provider ({providers}).

entries.newDescription: Choose the content type and locale. Translations are created from the original entry.
entries.noSchema: No schema has been applied to this workspace yet.
entries.migrationPending: Editing and publishing are paused while the schema migration is pending. They resume once it completes.
entries.title: Title
entries.slugHint: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used in the public URL.
entries.conflict: Someone else saved this draft first. Autosave is stopped so their changes are not overwritten. Reloading discards your unsaved changes, so copy anything you need first.
entries.leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
entries.unpublishDescription: Removes the entry from the public site. The draft and version history are kept.
entries.deleteDescription: Deletes the entry and stops publishing it. This cannot be undone from the admin.

publish.title: Review before publishing
publish.correctionDescription: Publishes this as a correction of an error. The fact of the correction and the affected sections are made public. The previous text and the diff are not.
publish.notSaved: There are unsaved changes, so this cannot be checked. Check the save status.
publish.missingAltHelp: Add alternative text or mark them as decorative. Entries with such images cannot be published.
publish.noUrl: Enter a slug to decide the public URL.
publish.urlChanged: The URL changes (was: {from}). The old URL is kept in the URL history.
publish.erased: The previous version's body was erased, so it cannot be compared.
publish.noChanges: No sections of the body changed.
publish.correctionHint: Numbers, dates or links changed in these sections. Is this a correction of an error? If so, use "Publish as correction": {sections}

translations.noSource: No source entry (this is the source, or there is none).
translations.reflected: The version at the time of creation is reflected
translations.reflectedNone: The source was not published when this was created
translations.members: Entries in the same translation group
translations.createHelp: Copies this entry's draft into a new entry in another locale.

settings.note: These switches are saved and changes are announced by webhook. Their effect on the chatbot and on materials for external AI comes in a later version.
settings.showDefaults: Show settings left at their defaults ({n})
settings.hideDefaults: Hide settings left at their defaults

useForChatbot.label: Use for the chatbot
useForChatbot.help: Use this entry as a source for the visitor chatbot's answers.

includeInAiMaterials.label: Include in materials for external AI
includeInAiMaterials.help: Include this entry in materials for external AI, such as the Markdown version and llms.txt.

optOutOfAiTraining.label: Opt out of AI training
optOutOfAiTraining.help: Mark the external materials so that they are not used for AI training.

urlHistory.empty: The public URL has not changed.

versions.empty: No version has been published yet.
versions.unknownNodes: This version contains elements the admin editor cannot display ({names}). Showing the text only.
versions.eraseDescription: Keeps the version's number, dates and other records, and removes only the body from every API. This cannot be undone.
versions.eraseCurrent: The published version cannot be erased. Publish a fixed version (as a correction), or unpublish the entry, and then erase it.
versions.eraseBackups: The erased content remains in database backups taken before the erasure.
versions.eraseMedia: Media that can be deleted with it
versions.eraseMediaHelp: Media used in this version and not used by any version or draft of any entry (translations included). Anyone with the URL can see media, so they are selected by default.
versions.eraseOtherLocalesHelp: Entries in the same translation group may still contain the same content in translation. Erase it in each entry if needed.

media.title: Media
media.deleteDescription: Deletes the file. This cannot be undone.
media.inUse: This media is used by entries. Their images will no longer be shown. Delete it anyway?

secretOnce.warning: This value is shown only now. Once closed it cannot be shown again, so store it somewhere safe.

members.removeDescription: Removes {email} from this workspace. Their entries and versions are kept.
members.passwordResetSent: A password reset email was sent to {email}.
members.mfaResetSent: An MFA reset email was sent to {email}.
members.passwordResetLink: Password reset link for {email} (give it to them)
members.mfaResetLink: MFA reset link for {email} (give it to them)

invitations.sent: An invitation email was sent to {email}.
invitations.link: Invitation link for {email} (give it to them)
invitations.revokeDescription: Revokes the invitation to {email}. The link sent will no longer work.

apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Revokes "{name}". Sites using this key will no longer be able to read the delivery API.

webhooks.help: Only https URLs that resolve to public addresses can be added. Entry events such as publishing and updates are sent with a signature.
webhooks.rotated: New signing secret for {url} (the old one also signs until {until})

audit.note: Only the kind of operation, who did it, the targets and the time are recorded (no content).
